sourceFingerprint.method: Sorted relative UTF-8 path + NUL + file bytes + NUL for all src, scripts, tests, content files; root package/lock/Next/Playwright/TypeScript/lint configs and catalogue manifest.

servers: Current demo with actual loopback HTTP receiver on 4110 and current production build; isolated from the user dev server on 3000.
webkitRuntime: Playwright WebKit 2359 WPE with Ubuntu ICU 74, libxml2 and flite extracted locally; software GStreamer sink. No system packages changed.
